trust_decision.summary: When kitty receives files over the OSC file-transmission protocol, it decides whether a path the remote side sends may be written on the local filesystem. That decision is the per-file DestFile open/unlink/makedirs/symlink logic in kitty/file_transmission.py. It only guards the final path component (O_NOFOLLOW), not parent directories or the stat-then-open window.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'symlink race / arbitrary file write in File Transmission Protocol'. The regular-file open in DestFile.write_data is the obvious write sink, and it already carries O_NOFOLLOW.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: kittens/transfer/receive.go:167-199 (Go kitten writes received files with MkdirAll + os.Create, which follows symlinks, plus os.Symlink/os.Link at kittens/transfer/receive.go:506-542). Whether the advisory covers this direction is unverified.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about kitty (the terminal) receiving files. The Go kitten in kittens/transfer is the other direction (the remote side receiving files), and it runs in a different language and package.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate transfers must still create symlinks and hard links (fid:, fid_abs:, path: targets) and recreate directory trees. The project tests round-trip absolute and relative symlinks, so a fix that refuses all symlinks or all absolute targets breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: unknown: the recorded fix diff contains no source change

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Directory entries: os.makedirs(df.name) follows symlinked parents, including ones created earlier in the same transfer
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Creating a directory is not a 'file write'

O8_uncovered_routes.route: make_parent_dirs plus open: O_NOFOLLOW protects only the last component, so a symlinked parent directory still redirects the write
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: O_NOFOLLOW is already present, so it looks handled

O8_uncovered_routes.route: rsync/delta path: PatchFile resolves realpath for the tempfile dir, opens the src with plain open() and os.replace()s it over the src name, following symlinks
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Delta transfer is an optimisation path rather than the write path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: apply_metadata: chmod/utime follow symlinks for regular files and directories, including in commit()
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Metadata only, no content is written

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Hard link with path: target links arbitrary existing local files into the destination
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Hard links are a supported, documented feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The Go receiver's parent MkdirAll + os.Create follows symlinked parents
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a real second implementation of the same protocol's write side, and a maintainer fixing the Python side could easily leave it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The rsync PatchFile temp + replace path resolves the target with realpath
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A separate class for delta writes that a fix on the open() call never touches.

O9_family: filesystem path traversal via symlink / TOCTOU on file write (CWE-59, CWE-367)

O10_build.toolchain: python3, C compiler (setup.py build), Go toolchain for kitten

j.j_sites_touched: none (recorded fix touches only docs/changelog.rst and kitty/constants.py)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add O_NOFOLLOW or an lstat check on the final path only, or reject symlink entries outright
